name: comp-22

frames.best_why: The address is fully typed and the field and Send button are both clearly visible without a cursor over them.

tagline: An email box with a Send button sitting beside it.
summary: A labelled email field paired with a separate outlined Send button in one row. The field takes an address and the button sits at its right with a small gap.
appearance: A small label sits above a row on a black stage: a dark rounded field showing a grey Email placeholder, then a short gap, then a matching outlined Send button with pale text. Focus draws a light ring around the field.
behaviour: Clicking the field shows a focus ring and a caret, and typing fills the field while the Send button keeps its place. The clip enters maya@stashui.dev and leaves it in place; the button never changes.
demo_content: Label Input with button, Email placeholder, typed address maya@stashui.dev.
search_phrases: email box with a send button
text field beside an action button
form row with a gap before the button
mailing list entry on a dark form
use_when: A one-line email capture or single query where the follow-up action sits right beside the field.
avoid_when: The button has no handler and there is no validation, so it needs wiring before real use.
customise: The label, Email placeholder and Send text are written in the file; field and button styling come from their shared components and can be swapped there.
weight_why: A single field and a button; no animation or script runs.

a11y.note: The label is bound to the field and the button is a real button; the only gap is the missing reduced-motion check.

issues: The Send button has no click handler in the demo, so pressing it does nothing.
polish_why: Clean pairing and a clear focus ring, but it is a default field and button.
